<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 375 812">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="375" height="812" fill="#000000"/>
  
  <!-- Status bar -->
  <text x="20" y="17" font-family="Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">9:41</text>
  <g fill="#FFFFFF">
    <rect x="306" y="12" width="3" height="5" rx="1"/>
    <rect x="311" y="10" width="3" height="7" rx="1"/>
    <rect x="316" y="8" width="3" height="9" rx="1"/>
    <rect x="321" y="6" width="3" height="11" rx="1"/>
  </g>
  <g stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.6" fill="none">
    <path d="M333 10 C337 6, 343 6, 347 10"/>
    <path d="M336 13 C339 10, 342 10, 345 13"/>
  </g>
  <circle cx="340.5" cy="16" r="1.3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="354" y="7" width="20" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.4"/>
  <rect x="356" y="9" width="14" height="7" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="375" y="10" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Netflix wordmark -->
  <text x="187.5" y="52" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="25" font-weight="900" letter-spacing="2.2" fill="#EE1520">NETFLIX</text>

  <!-- Promotional illustration -->
  <g>
    <rect x="12" y="72" width="351" height="240" rx="2" fill="#131313"/>
    <rect x="12" y="72" width="351" height="240" rx="2" fill="#00000042"/>
    <rect x="31" y="91" width="313" height="202" rx="2" fill="#1A1A1A"/>
    <circle cx="293" cy="126" r="29" fill="#B1060F" opacity=".72"/>
    <circle cx="293" cy="126" r="16" fill="#EE1520" opacity=".72"/>
    <polygon points="50,272 121,196 163,238 216,174 325,272" fill="#585858"/>
    <polygon points="50,272 121,196 145,222 102,272" fill="#737373"/>
    <circle cx="91" cy="137" r="17" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <rect x="119" y="119" width="92" height="132" rx="9" fill="#000000" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="128" y="132" width="74" height="90" rx="2" fill="#B1060F"/>
    <text x="165" y="184" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="34" font-weight="900" fill="#FFFFFF">N</text>
    <circle cx="165" cy="238" r="8" fill="#EE1520"/>
    <line x1="165" y1="238" x2="165" y2="202" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="3"/>
    <polyline points="153,214 165,202 177,214" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="3"/>
    <rect x="45" y="283" width="285" height="2" fill="#FFFFFF33"/>
    <rect x="45" y="283" width="173" height="2" fill="#EE1520"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Onboarding copy -->
  <text x="187.5" y="366" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="30" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Download and watch</text>
  <text x="187.5" y="401" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="30" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">offline</text>
  <text x="187.5" y="438" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">Save your favorite shows and movies</text>
  <text x="187.5" y="463" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">to watch whenever you want.</text>

  <!-- Help and privacy -->
  <text x="92" y="526" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF82">Help</text>
  <line x1="119" y1="516" x2="119" y2="530" stroke="#FFFFFF33" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="172" y="526" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF82">Privacy</text>
  <line x1="218" y1="516" x2="218" y2="530" stroke="#FFFFFF33" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="280" y="526" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF82">Terms</text>

  <!-- Pagination -->
  <circle cx="169" cy="565" r="4" fill="#EE1520"/>
  <circle cx="187.5" cy="565" r="4" fill="#FFFFFF5C"/>
  <circle cx="206" cy="565" r="4" fill="#FFFFFF5C"/>

  <!-- Sign in action -->
  <g>
    <rect x="12" y="690" width="351" height="44" rx="2" fill="#00000042"/>
    <rect x="12" y="688" width="351" height="44" rx="2" fill="#EE1520"/>
    <text x="187.5" y="716" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">SIGN IN</text>
  </g>
  <text x="187.5" y="765" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF82">Enjoy Netflix on your favorite devices</text>
</svg>
